t: How the Definition and Terminology Resolver works (Signature)
title: How the Definition and Terminology Resolver works (Signature)
description: Signature record. Overview: what the Definition and Terminology Resolver does and why archives need it. Signature original. The Signature approach keeps a definition ledger per domain: every term-sense pair stores its definition, its source glossary, and the context signatures that select it. Disambiguation follows fixed, recorded scoring — overlap weights and domain priors are frozen per run — so the same passage always resolves the same way. Meaning-drift is tracked as dated ledger entries, letting the archive show what a term meant in 1940 versus today. This is a Signature-authored method, original to Justin Addam Higgins.
provenance: Signature-authored original method by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH). Property of Justin Addam Higgins.
